verdict.rationale: Canva's Apps SDK brings new design and editing experiences into the editor, and apps can be distributed publicly through the Apps Marketplace. Those apps can import content, add elements and automate design tasks, and audit logs record users installing Canva Apps, so a marketplace-based extension path clearly exists. Missing for 10: evidence that the marketplace is large or has an active community, specific examples of icon, data-filler or accessibility-checker apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
